verdict.rationale: An IP office portal with search, e-filing and status-tracking services could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, for example on similar marks or application status, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional search, filing, tracking, fee and publication pages, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions. The llms.txt probe returned a 404, but that concerns agent-facing docs rather than in-product AI insights, so it does not bear on this story.
